label: visual-only
vendored_note: Nothing was downloaded or vendored. The bake imports the repo's own Bird & Hulstrom model and uses published constants; no third-party code or asset ships.

sources.name: Bird & Hulstrom 1981, A Simplified Clear Sky Model for Direct and Diffuse Insolation on Horizontal Surfaces (SERI/TR-642-761), as implemented in core/scenario/solar.py
sources.licence: US government technical report (public domain); repo code
sources.used_for: sun direct normal illuminance under a stated aerosol optical depth; forward-scatter share Ba = 0.84 and aerosol absorptance K1 = 0.1 for the haze-scattered sky term (this lane's MODEL step, UNCALIBRATED)

sources.name: IES RP-21 clear-sky horizontal diffuse illuminance, constants as stated in core/scene/beauty_look.py IES_CLEAR_DIFFUSE_KLX
sources.used_for: clear part of the sky diffuse illuminance

sources.name: Koschmieder 1924, Theorie der horizontalen Sichtweite (Beitr. Phys. freien Atm. 12, 33-53): visibility = 3.912 / extinction at the 2 % contrast threshold
Angstrom 1929, On the atmospheric transmission of sun radiation and on dust in the air (Geografiska Annaler 11, 156-166): aerosol optical depth proportional to wavelength^-alpha
sources.licence: published formula (fact); the exponent 0.7 and the 1.2 km scale height are UNCALIBRATED picks
sources.used_for: aerosol optical depth at 500 and 380 nm from 550 nm

sources.name: Cox & Munk 1954, Measurement of the roughness of the sea surface from photographs of the sun's glitter (J. Opt. Soc. Am. 44, 838-850): mean-square slope = 0.003 + 0.00512 U
sources.licence: published formula (fact); wind 5 m/s is an UNCALIBRATED pick
sources.used_for: sun glitter peak luminance on the sea (reference column only; it does not set exposure)

sources.name: ISO 2720:1974 incident-light exposure meter calibration, C = 250
Lagarde & de Rousiers 2014, Moving Frostbite to Physically Based Rendering (SIGGRAPH course notes), saturation-based exposure Lmax = 1.2 * 2^EV100
sources.used_for: scene-linear value of a luminance at a manual EV100

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: sosfuse2
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: twilight only (sun +6 to -18 deg) and mixed-licence bundled inputs (CC BY-SA among them); the coastal table stops at 1 deg above the horizon. Unvetted, not fetched. The follow-up if the scenario extends into dusk.

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: Poly Haven pure-sky HDRIs / Qwantani series
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: CC0 and the right cross-check for the low-sun sun:sky ratio, but a large fetch that changes no shipped number today; named in INTEGRATION.md as the calibration follow-up.

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: MoonShineR
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: GPL-3 offline tool with a night and twilight focus. Not needed for a daylight table.

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: skylight (bluegreen-labs)
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: AGPL-3.0; the repo already has a daylight direct model. Not fetched.

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: Filament scotopicAdaptation
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: low-light colour shift; belongs to a colour-grading lane.

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: Prague Sky Model dataset
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: it covers visibility and low sun, so it is the best reference for the haze-scattered sky term, but it is multi-GB and its licence is only 'as stated on record', unverified. Not fetched.

research_candidates_not_adopted.name: PerezSky
research_candidates_not_adopted.reason: MIT, but it needs DNI/DHI as inputs, which is what this table lacks a measured source for; overcast states go through exposure_target's existing overcast stops.
